integrity: Complete written proof and a reproducible exact finite facet determinant and f-vector check; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Counts toric resolutions as morphisms over the fixed fan; does not determine abstract-isomorphism classes, coherence chambers, non-toric models or derived categories. Earlier triangulations are known. Possible unrecognized equivalent toric-resolution result.
title: Small crepant resolutions of the toric D4 24-cell: 3^24 choices and their cohomology
